_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or counted here from a list a quote carries.

grant_usd.basis: grant from the San Antonio Medical Foundation, as UT Health San Antonio states it

study_years.basis: the pilot is a one year proof of concept study

norman_years.basis: years Rocio Norman has worked with veterans

features_named.basis: features the team names that it plans to assess: coherence, emotional tone, organization, level of detail

symptoms_named.basis: symptoms named that the differences will be compared with

recording_prompts.basis: what veterans described in the recordings: how they were injured, an important life event

tests_built_for.basis: the conditions most adult language assessments were developed for, per Norman: aphasia after a stroke, severe brain injury
